items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: I guess he said either get Arbenz or the Imperial Method.

ctx.x: By the way, when you did take lessons, did he charge you for it?
Oh, no, he never, he never charged. He never charged. He told me to get this book. I guess he said either get Arbenz or the Imperial Method. And so I got the Imperial Method.
Remember where that was published or who wrote it?
